evidence: A commenter praises Janet's portability and lightweight runtime and says they use it for all their agentic scripts.

evidence_sources.author: phillc73
evidence_sources.excerpt: The beautiful thing about Janet is how lightweight and portable it is, no JVM. I use Janet for all my agentic scripting. Python is forbidden in my harness. Janet scripts for everything. Love it.

source_story_title: Jank – The native Clojure dialect with seamless C++ interop
